episodes.overviewEn: In an effort to fit in, Wanda and Vision perform a magic act in their community talent show.

episodes.overviewEn: Wanda's pregnancy fritzes her powers as she and Vision prepare for an accelerated delivery.

episodes.overviewEn: Monica Rambeau, tasked with a special assignment regarding sentient weapons, goes missing.

episodes.overviewEn: Wanda addresses Vision's worries when he grows suspicious of the neighbors' strange behavior.

episodes.overviewEn: Disturbances on Halloween separate Wanda from Vision, who looks into anomalous activity in Westview.

episodes.overviewEn: Monica plots her return to the anomaly while Wanda navigates a slew of unsettling complications, and Vision forms a new alliance to help.

episodes.name: Previously On
episodes.overviewEn: Wanda embarks on a troubling journey revisiting her past for insight into her present and future.

episodes.name: The Series Finale
episodes.overviewEn: The events of WandaVision come to a head, and the destinies of all who took part are determined.
